text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine"...
Zenno Rob Roy, Neo Universe
understands.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Inserting the solidified "CACC"...
Forced injection of "Excitement"... check.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean... giving you chocolates?
If so, that is indeed correct, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Other memories, too.
Across the ocean... it's a "two-way street."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging "gifts" to intensify
our mutual gravitational pull...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe in another universe, however,
could not...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because I can't give it to them.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe――will take revenge.
It's "TACS."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Uni-san?
Uni-san, where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――“AMRT”。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, "AMRT."

It didn't seem like she meant simply "receiving chocolate."
I could feel a determination far beyond that.

What is "AMRT"? Accepting the chocolate,
I decided to tackle it head-on to find out.
(Flap!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “AMRT”……。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you."
"Neo Universe" will...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
More—"AMRT".
Not just the circulation between α and β, but...

It doesn't seem to mean
"I want lots of presents." In that case—

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is your Valentine's Special Plate♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's... "AMRT."

I finally grasp the nuance.
Neo Universe wishes
to "deepen our bond."

We decided to visit as many places
as time would allow.
(Whooosh, whooosh!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The ocean was... so blue...
We can look at it side by side... right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “AMRT”……。
(Eek-eek-kiki! Pawoooon!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There is a wide variety of organisms on this planet...
I can "AWAK" even in a single Earth day.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “AMRT”……！

The excitement gradually began to build.
Eventually, their mindwaves completely aligned—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer—they're coming.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"TRYS"... can be done.
Toward the "nayuta" horizon...
And so, the place the two of them visited was...
—It was a nighttime tower where they could quietly converse.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
What about the Neo Universe of another universe...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't make it.
Because it was "DAZT"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "outliers" are quarantined.
However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I was able to overcome it.
Through the "Tesseract."

Now that our bond has deepened, we can go anywhere.
Anywhere at all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
(Vrrrrooooom!!)

—I have no memory of what happened after that.
When I woke up... I was in a park
just a stone's throw from my apartment.

Still in a daze,
I glanced up at the clock tower standing in the park—

The hand clicked,
striking midnight on February 15th.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

—It was an unfamiliar city. Yet, somehow
it felt familiar. This plaza is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"San Babila," huh.
If we walk a bit from here—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I was told there's a place called 'Via Monte Napoleone.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe had 'longed' for it.
Ever since being told..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: One day, together... we shall "return home."

text_block_list.name: Milanese Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ecco i caffe.
Scusate per l'attesa.
(Sorry to keep you waiting. Here is your espresso.)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……wanted to talk.
During the "itinerary"――"RCOL."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, unfamiliar GⅠs... Victory and defeat alike... are all 'Planetes.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Memories—in my "homeland"...
It's something I've dreamed of for so long...

"I simply listen closely to Neo Universe's words.
Yes—"

We could have gone anywhere together.
We were supposed to...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“But... ‘CEBR’...
This is fine...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because right now—I can.

The two of us take our time, enjoying our café visit.
A Valentine's Day somewhere, sometime. And then—

As if blessing the long-awaited moment,
the bells of the Duomo chimed endlessly.
